# opsramp_alert_correlation_policy (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp Alert Correlation Policy. Correlates related alerts to reduce noise and identify root causes.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the alert correlation policy.

### Optional

- `algorithm_correlation` (Attributes) Algorithm-based correlation settings. Used when type is `ALGORITHM`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--algorithm_correlation))
- `client` (String) The client (tenant) UUID where this policy should be created. If not specified, uses the provider's tenant.
- `enabled_mode` (String) The enabled mode of the policy. Valid values: `ON`, `OFF`, `OBSERVED`.
- `filter_query` (String) Filter query to scope which alerts are evaluated by this policy.
- `inference_query` (String) Inference query to scope which alerts are used for inference.
- `inference_subject` (String) Template for the inference alert subject. Use `$subject` as a placeholder.
- `machine_learning` (Attributes) Machine learning settings for alert correlation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_learning))
- `precedence` (Number) The execution order of the policy. Lower values execute first.
- `review` (Boolean) Whether the policy is in review mode.
- `type` (String) The alert correlation policy type. Valid values: `DEPENDENCY`, `ALGORITHM`, `CO_OCCURRENCE`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the alert correlation policy.

<a id="nestedatt--algorithm_correlation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `algorithm_correlation`

Optional:

- `alert_trigger` (Attributes) Alert trigger conditions for algorithm correlation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--algorithm_correlation--alert_trigger))
- `alerts_time_window` (String) Time window in minutes for correlating alerts.
- `matching_conditions` (Attributes List) Conditions for matching correlated alerts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--algorithm_correlation--matching_conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--algorithm_correlation--alert_trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `algorithm_correlation.alert_trigger`

Optional:

- `duration` (Number) Duration in minutes for the trigger.
- `rules` (Attributes List) List of trigger rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--algorithm_correlation--alert_trigger--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--algorithm_correlation--alert_trigger--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `algorithm_correlation.alert_trigger.rules`

Required:

- `entity_name` (String) The entity name.
- `entity_value` (String) The value to compare against.
- `operator` (String) The comparison operator.



<a id="nestedatt--algorithm_correlation--matching_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `algorithm_correlation.matching_conditions`

Required:

- `match_type` (String) The type of match.
- `property` (String) The alert property to match on.



<a id="nestedatt--machine_learning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machine_learning`

Optional:

- `continuous_learning` (Boolean) Whether continuous learning is enabled.
- `matching_conditions` (Attributes List) Conditions for matching co-occurring alerts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_learning--matching_conditions))
- `topology` (Boolean) Whether topology-based correlation is enabled.
- `topology_depth` (Number) The depth of topology traversal for correlation.

<a id="nestedatt--machine_learning--matching_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machine_learning.matching_conditions`

Required:

- `match_type` (String) The type of match.
- `property` (String) The alert property to match on.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "opsramp_alert_correlation_policy" "similarity_correlation_policy" {
  name = "Similarity-based"

  enabled_mode    = "OBSERVED"
  filter_query    = ""
  inference_query = ""
  type            = "CO_OCCURRENCE"
  machine_learning = {
    continuous_learning = true
    topology            = false
    matching_conditions = [
      {
        property   = "service_group"
        match_type = "Identical"
      }
    ]
  }

  inference_subject = ""
}
```

```terraform
resource "opsramp_alert_correlation_policy" "topology_correlation_policy" {
  name = "Topology-based"

  enabled_mode    = "OBSERVED"
  filter_query    = ""
  inference_query = ""
  type            = "CO_OCCURRENCE"
  machine_learning = {
    continuous_learning = true
    topology            = true
    topology_depth      = 3
  }

  inference_subject = ""
}
```
